provenance_note: brand_extract.py on caveman.so returned confidence=low (frequency heuristic only) but its fire-orange accent #f36716 matches the project's visible identity (a 'primitive fire' motif on a token-compression tool). A second pass on the docs subdomain (juliusbrussee.github.io/caveman) returned confidence=high for canvas and ink via real CSS variables (--bg, --text-primary) but its own accent was just white-on-white (no real accent declared). Per routine step 6.3, assembled the token set from both: canvas+ink from the high-confidence docs site, accent from the coherent low-confidence caveman.so evidence.

provenance.canvas: juliusbrussee.github.io/caveman css var --bg, nudged off pure black (confidence high)
provenance.ink: juliusbrussee.github.io/caveman css var --text-primary, softened from pure white (confidence high)
provenance.accent: caveman.so frequency-heuristic most-saturated color (#f36716, the site's own fire-orange), lightened to #f68d50 in the screening loop: the raw value sat right on the readability gate's dark/light luma boundary (~136), which starved the inverted flash scene's luma spread (112, needed 120); lightening to luma ~165 gave the bright field real margin without losing the fire-orange identity

readability.accent_is_graphic_not_text: raw #f68d50 (luma ~165, lightened from the mined #f36716 to clear the flash scene's inverted-field spread floor) stays on dots, fills, strokes, and glows; --accent-ink (accent blended toward ink to ~205 luma) used for any accent-colored hero text so it doesn't read dim on near-black
readability.muted_content_rule: activity lines and detail rows use --muted-content (muted blended 60% toward ink); raw ink_muted (#888888) stays for decorative-only corner tags

per_scene_light_source.1_title: hero wordmark 'caveman' in full ink weight fills most of the frame width, JetBrainsMono at hero scale -- the light source IS the type mass, poster-ready at frame 0
per_scene_light_source.2_diagram: architecture nodes/rules in ink with one accent node (the skill-injection step) glowing as the through-line; rule-lines carry the midground plate
per_scene_light_source.3_terminal: terminal pane on a slightly lifted near-black plate so typed ink text (the real /caveman command and output) keeps contrast; accent tags the prompt char
per_scene_light_source.4_stack_receipt: bold ink numerals (1,180 to 159 tokens) at hero scale against the dark plate, accent used only on the down-arrow motion/glyph, not the numeral text
per_scene_light_source.5_sparkline: sparkline drawn in accent with an end-dot glow, big_number star count-up in full ink -- brightest, busiest frame in the piece
per_scene_light_source.6_flash_inverted: INVERTED beat: bright accent-lit field, dark ink type carrying the 'wenyan' surprising detail -- the one polarity flip, contrast budget spent here
per_scene_light_source.7_mono_block_honesty: mono_block quoting the README's own net-negative caveat in ink on the dark plate, small accent rule underneath
per_scene_light_source.8_close: wordmark rhymes with scene 1 composition for the autoloop, same type mass as the light source

readability.inverted_beat: scene 6 (flash) flips to a bright accent-lit field so the piece isn't one flat near-black wash for the whole runtime
